title: deployment-fallback-experimentation-and-operational-lessons
creator: Maya Chen
description:
Summary: After a recent staged rollout where a new decoder quantization variant triggered latency spikes and subtle generation regressions for ~12% of requests, we held an incident review and agreed to a focused follow-up workstream. This ticket consolidates the operational learnings, expands automated safety checks, and prototypes an independent 'synthetic shadow' harness to validate model behavior under production traffic patterns before weighted canaries.

Problem statement: Our canary pipeline currently relies on metrics surfaced by production traffic and a small hold window. The failure showed three gaps: 1) insufficient synthetic checks for semantic regression (we only check token-level logs and latency), 2) rollback heuristics were tuned for hard failures (errors/5xx) and not for SLO drift or subtle quality regressions, and 3) shadow traffic tooling lacks a lightweight deterministic replay path to exercise KV-cache and batching behavior deterministically.

Goals for this ticket:
- Define and implement a synthetic shadow test harness that replays representative production request samples (anonymized) against candidate model variants in a controlled environment (no customer traffic impact).
- Expand canary gating to include model-quality signals (eval-set regression detection, embedding-drift thresholds, and top-k logit distribution shifts) in addition to latency/error thresholds.
- Improve auto-rollback rules to support soft-rollbacks and staged throttled rollbacks (weight decays) with alerting and manual override hooks.
- Update runbooks with checklists, playbook snippets and decision heuristics for ambiguous regressions (quality vs. latency trade-offs).

Success criteria:
- Synthetic shadow harness runs automatically for all canary builds and produces a concise summary (pass/fail + top 5 diffs) within the canary hold window.
- Auto-rollback triggers for combined quality+latency breaches (e.g., >5% eval regression AND >15% p95 latency regressions) and performs an observable weight-decay fallback instead of abrupt full rollback by default.
- Runbook updates accepted by SRE and PM and a tabletop drill scheduled in the next cycle.
updates: 2026-03-06: Initial incident review led by Maya. Root cause hypothesis: quantized kernel path exposed a micro-timing regression interacting with KV cache alignment. Agreement to build synthetic shadow suite.

2026-03-07: Eng spike (Lars) to prototype replay harness using anonymized sample set from prod-analytic corpus (S3 path: s3://redwood-prod-samples/canary-replay/2026-02). Prototype runs deterministically in CPU-mode and reproduces latency variance observed in canary. PR: github.com/redwood/replay-harness/pull/78.

2026-03-08: PM meeting: agreed gating thresholds and escalation flow. Decided on composite signal: (eval_regression_pct >= 5 AND p95_latency_delta >= 15%) OR error_rate >= 0.5% triggers auto-rollback. Documented in Confluence: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/INF/pages/6798123/Canary+Gating+Rules.

2026-03-09: Design and Ops reviewed proposed runbook additions. Added explicit checklist for 'ambiguous regressions' that requires 1) replay results, 2) top-decode diff sample, 3) embedding-similarity report. Runbook draft: drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB-example-runbook.

2026-03-11: Implemented telemetry hooks in the canary controller to emit model-quality signals (eval harness scores, embedding drift, top-k logit KL). Feature branch: github.com/redwood/canary-controller/compare/feature/model-quality-signals (PR #212). Unit tests written; integration failing intermittently in CI because of environment-specific RNG seeds (tuned RNG seeding in PR).

notes: Trade-offs discussed: stricter auto-rollback avoids user-facing regressions but increases false-positives (throttled rollback and human-in-loop default reduces churn).

Synthetic shadow must simulate KV-cache and batching to catch alignment regressions; naive request replay without cache warmup missed the issue in the original canary. Plan: include warmup phase that replays prefix tokens to populate caches.
We will compute embedding-drift using cosine similarity on a fixed anchor set. Thresholds need empirical tuning — initial threshold set to mean-3sigma from historical deltas.

Consider adding a lightweight A/B experiment that runs in parallel to a canary: 1% live traffic with sampling of user segments flagged as tolerant to quality variance. This is outside the current ticket scope but logged as ENG-33101.
SRE requested that auto-rollback expose both 'full rollback' and 'weight-decay' runbook actions; default to weight-decay with a 10-minute hold and automated escalation if metrics do not recover.
